name: imagepay-mcp
description: x402 pay-per-call image, PDF, QR and utility micro-API marketplace for AI agents. 40 tools gated by USDC micro-payments on Base (no API key). Connect over Streamable HTTP — no install required.

http.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint. No install or API key required — point any MCP client at this URL. Each call is paid individually via x402 (USDC on Base) through facilitator https://facilitator.payai.network.
